title: Snapchat will no longer recommend ‘wholly AI-generated videos’ in its vertical video feed.
summary: “As low-quality, repetitive, AI-generated content becomes increasingly common across the internet, we want Spotlight to remain a place where people can discover authentic creativity from real people,” Snap says .
